rows.label: Your San Pedro answer
rows.article: So why not just blast right past that part
source: This is also why I caution against forcing your way
Learn to do inner-child therapy sober
notes: Your answer 5: San Pedro, especially at lower doses, needs less Nurturer and Protector built up, like MDMA; your good childhood; you squandered that opportunity. The caution now comes first, then "How much is enough depends on the drug", then San Pedro.

"though you still need some" is mine: a reviewer worried that a reader who is still mostly the scared kid would hear "you don't need as much" as "you don't need any". "How much is enough depends on the drug" is mine too, joining the caution to your San Pedro point.
Pangram alone: 100% Human (149).

carries.draft: Like MDMA, San Pedro is more protective and nurturing than many other drugs, especially at lower doses, so you don't need as much Nurturer and Protector built up for it, though you still need some.
I already had some from my good childhood to draw on.
But I still squandered that opportunity: with a better understanding of reparenting, it could have been much more therapeutic.
